question: In a certain code language, 'BONE' is written as 'F15R5'. How will 'NOSE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘BONE' is written as 'F15R5’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b2576c858f54b69339c142966c624b69d3d329ccaebbb3607102bc5e7f282e2.png] 

Similarly, for '**NOSE**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45c50746cbe98bdc0e9c6868c743bfa044cef59403517672361bc7e2d1bdfb06.png] 

So, '**NOSE**' will be written as 'R15W5'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
